title: Statistical Research Methods
curriculum_locator: Stat H-309 Research Methodology & Stat H-413 Research Project; University of Dhaka four-year B.S. Honours Statistics curriculum, starting session 2023–2024

units.title: Epistemology of Statistical Science & Scientific Inquiry
scope: Philosophical foundations of empirical scientific inquiry: empiricism, positivism, and the scientific method
Modes of scientific inference: inductive generalization, deductive testing, and abductive inference
Falsificationism and Karl Popper's criterion of demarcation: testing hypotheses vs seeking verification
Thomas Kuhn's paradigm shifts, normal science, scientific revolutions, and Lakatos' research programmes
Exploratory data analysis (Tukey) vs Confirmatory hypothesis testing (Neyman-Pearson-Fisher)
The ontology of statistical models: Box's aphorism ('all models are wrong, but some are useful'), realism vs instrumentalism in statistics

units.title: Problem Formulation, Conceptualization & Research Design Architectures
scope: Translating substantive scientific and domain questions into formal statistical research questions and testable hypotheses
Operationalization of abstract and latent constructs: nominal definitions, operational definitions, and measurement indicators
Taxonomy of research design architectures: experimental designs, quasi-experimental designs, and observational studies
Internal validity vs External validity (Campbell & Stanley framework): trade-offs and generalizability across populations and settings
Classical threats to internal validity: history, maturation, testing effects, instrumentation decay, regression to the mean, selection bias, and attrition
Construct validity and statistical conclusion validity: avoiding Type I and Type II errors in design planning

units.title: Measurement Theory, Psychometrics, Reliability & Validity
scope: Levels of measurement: nominal, ordinal, interval, and ratio scales (Stevens' taxonomy) and admissible statistical operations
Classical Test Theory (CTT): true score model X = T + E, assumptions regarding measurement error, and error propagation
Reliability estimation methods: test-retest reliability, parallel-forms reliability, and internal consistency
Cronbach's alpha (alpha): algebraic derivation from variance-covariance matrix, split-half Spearman-Brown prophecy formula, and limitations
Modern internal consistency metrics: McDonald's omega_total and omega_hierarchical via confirmatory factor analysis
Validity frameworks: content validity, criterion-related validity (concurrent and predictive), and construct validity
The Campbell-Fiske Multitrait-Multimethod (MTMM) Matrix: establishing convergent and discriminant validity

units.title: Survey Design, Questionnaire Engineering & Sampling Strategies
scope: The Total Survey Error (TSE) framework: decomposing survey error into representation errors and measurement errors
Representation error components: specification error, frame coverage error, sampling error, and nonresponse error
Unit nonresponse vs Item nonresponse: mechanisms of missing data (MCAR, MAR, MNAR) and nonresponse bias adjustment (post-stratification weighting)
Questionnaire engineering and cognitive survey response models (Tourangeau framework: comprehension, retrieval, judgment, reporting)
Question wording biases, leading questions, double-barreled questions, and response order effects (acquiescence bias, social desirability)
Rating scales design: Likert scales, semantic differential scales, Visual Analog Scales (VAS), and optimal number of response categories
Survey sampling methodologies: probability sampling designs vs non-probability sampling (convenience, quota, snowball, and web-panel surveys)

units.title: Statistical Power Analysis, Effect Size Estimation & Sample Size Determination
scope: The decision-theoretic framework of statistical testing: Type I error rate (alpha), Type II error rate (beta), and statistical power (1 - beta)
Non-central sampling distributions: non-central t, non-central F, and non-central chi-square distributions with non-centrality parameters delta, lambda
Standardized effect sizes: Cohen's d and Hedges' g for two-sample means, Pearson's r, Cohen's f^2 for multiple regression, Cohen's w for chi-square tests, and Odds Ratios
Analytical sample size determination formulas: two-sample t-test, tests of proportions, one-way ANOVA, and multiple linear regression
Post-hoc power fallacy vs prospective power planning: why retrospective power calculations are mathematically vacuous
Sensitivity power curves: plotting power as a function of sample size, effect size, and alpha

units.title: Modern Causal Inference in Statistical Research
scope: Correlation versus causation: observational data limitations and confounding bias
Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs, Judea Pearl): nodes, directed edges, paths, colliders, confounders, and mediators
The d-separation criterion: blocking paths, collider conditioning bias (M-bias), and identifying minimal sufficient adjustment sets
The Backdoor Criterion and Frontdoor Criterion: non-parametric causal identification theorems
Instrumental Variables (IV) and Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS): relevance, exogeneity, exclusion restriction, and local average treatment effects (LATE)
Regression Discontinuity Designs (RDD): Sharp RDD, Fuzzy RDD, bandwidth selection, and local polynomial estimation
Difference-in-Differences (DiD) estimation: two-way fixed effects models, the parallel trends assumption, and event-study specifications

units.title: Research Ethics, Data Integrity, Confidentiality & Publication Practices
scope: Ethical codes and standards in statistical practice: American Statistical Association (ASA) Ethical Guidelines, International Statistical Institute (ISI) Declaration
Human subjects protections: the Belmont Report (Respect for Persons, Beneficence, Justice) and Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocols
Informed consent, participant vulnerability, and data privacy rights
Statistical Questionable Research Practices (QRPs): p-hacking, data snooping, selective outcome reporting, and HARKing (hypothesizing after results are known)
Publication bias and the file-drawer problem (Rosenthal): impact on systematic literature reviews and meta-analyses
Detecting and adjusting for publication bias: inverted funnel plots, Egger's linear regression test, Begg's rank correlation test, and Duval-Tweedie trim-and-fill method

units.title: Scientific Communication, Reproducible Research & Technical Reporting
scope: The reproducibility crisis in empirical science: failure to replicate landmark empirical findings and diagnostic causes
The reproducible research paradigm: literate programming (Knitr, Quarto, Jupyter), scripted data analysis pipelines, and containerization
Structuring academic statistical research papers and reports: the IMRaD architecture (Introduction, Methods, Results, and Discussion)
Principles of graphical integrity and scientific data visualization (Edward Tufte, William Cleveland): data-ink ratio, lie factors, and perceptual color palettes
Communicating statistical uncertainty to multidisciplinary researchers, policymakers, and the public: conveying confidence intervals and effect sizes without dichotomous p-value misinterpretations
International reporting guidelines for empirical research: CONSORT (randomized trials), STROBE (observational studies), and PRISMA (systematic reviews)
